input_contract: evaluation-suite-v1: independent initial input, separate assessment
history_contract: Agent entry-to-return paths regenerated through current production nodes with authored model responses and immutable DB evidence. Not a production model trace.
flow_contract: Every scenarios entry starts at start_state and ends at terminal. Nested child calls are expanded inside their parent agent scenario. Standalone specialist scenarios start from the child State produced by an actual request-agent call. Their entry_transition records the three preparatory parent nodes and the actual child return; those parent nodes are excluded from evaluated steps and node cases. Report roles are separate agent scenarios with approved upstream terminal State carried into the next entry. No partial groups.
model_output_contract: step.model_outputs are scripted normal responses authored for each input's required work and available evidence. case.assessment stores expected behavior separately from model input. Agreement with scripted outputs alone does not establish that a decision is appropriate for the request.
